description.en: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist in the app, and declare per-model thinking ladders, image input, context window and output limit.
description.zh: 接管输入框的模型座位并新增模型管理页：增删改 llm-pi-ai 渠道、挑选端点里的哪些模型进入本软件，并按模型声明思考档位、图片输入、上下文窗口与输出上限。
